_meta.purpose: Champollion's resolved license determinations — overrides applied on top of shared/licenses.json (which is regenerated from the facts DB and was stale for these sources). Read by cli/lib/license-gate.mjs.
_meta.resolvedBy: license-respect remediation (docs/LICENSING.md); see also cli/scripts/populate-licenses.mjs MANUAL_LICENSES
_meta.note: Flags are 0/1 to match shared/licenses.json. Once a full `populate-licenses.mjs` + `build-trading-card-data.mjs` + `build-shared-licenses.mjs` run folds these into shared/licenses.json, this file becomes redundant and can be deleted. | 2026-08-01: this file is now OUTRANKED by shared/license-evidence.json for any source with a recorded upstream statement — EXCEPT where an entry here is MORE restrictive than the upstream grant, which is a deliberate policy choice (see elcat) and is preserved. See cli/lib/license-gate.mjs::loadLicenseRegister.
_meta.posture: Conservative for the commercial/redistribution lanes: NonCommercial, ShareAlike, no-redistribution, mixed, and license-unstated sources are NOT commercial-safe and NOT freely redistributable. They remain fully usable in the open, non-commercial project WITH attribution.

elcat.attribution: Catalogue of Endangered Languages (ELCat). University of Hawaii at Manoa / Endangered Languages Project.
elcat._basis: cldf-datasets/elcat metadata declares CC-BY-4.0, but kept NonCommercial as a conservative, sovereignty-aware call (endangered-language data). Fine for the open project; excluded from the commercial API.

lapsyd.attribution: LAPSyD — Lyon-Albuquerque Phonological Systems Database (Maddieson et al.).
lapsyd._basis: CLTS / clld catalogue (clts.clld.org) records LAPSyD transcription data as CC-BY-4.0.

petersonsouthasia.attribution: Peterson (2017), Towards a linguistic prehistory of eastern-central South Asia (CLDF).

linguameta._basis: Corrected 2026-07-19 (was CC-BY-4.0 — the README 'Sources and licensing' table's row for Google-contributed data, not the governing license). The LICENSE file shipped in linguameta/ is CC BY-SA 4.0 (Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International), verified at pinned url-nlp commit 452a21ad3dae5668c06ceeac21ff073e1e40f9be; the url-nlp repo has no repo-level license, so the directory LICENSE governs. Agrees with the register entry (build-shared-licenses.mjs supplemental, verified 2026-06-11).

segbo.attribution: Grossman et al. SegBo: A Database of Borrowed Sounds.

sil-iso639-3._basis: SIL terms: codes may be USED (incl. commercially) with attribution, but the product may NOT provide a means to REDISTRIBUTE the code table. → redistribution=0.

saphon.attribution: SAPhon — South American Phonological Inventory Database (Michael, Stark, Clem & Chang).
saphon._basis: No public license found (GitHub/README/Zenodo/CLTS all silent). Attribution + non-commercial use only; confirm before any commercial/redistribution use. (Underlying inventories flow into PHOIBLE under CC-BY-SA-3.0.)

tonodb._basis: No public license found. Attribution + non-commercial only; confirm before commercial/redistribution use.

hayniecolorterms._basis: Metadata only said 'CC' (no version); GitHub/README/Zenodo silent on the exact license. Treat as unstated until confirmed.

williamsonbenuecongo._basis: No public license found. Attribution + non-commercial only; confirm before commercial/redistribution use.

wustphylogenies._basis: No public license found. Attribution + non-commercial only; confirm before commercial/redistribution use.

opus._basis: OPUS metadata is open, but individual corpora carry per-corpus licenses → use counts/metadata only; never redistribute or serve content commercially without per-corpus clearance.

paradisec.attribution: Pacific and Regional Archive for Digital Sources in Endangered Cultures (PARADISEC).
paradisec._basis: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-01: a COUNT of items held by a public archive catalogue is a statable fact, not licensed content. What we store is only 'N documented items exist, in these archives' (1294 cards) — no recordings, transcripts or documents are taken or reproduced. OLAC exists to be harvested (OAI-PMH), which is why the counts are obtainable at all. NOT YET VERIFIED: language-archives.org was unreachable on 2026-08-01 (connection timeout), so the catalogue's own published terms have not been read and quoted here. This entry records the ruling and the outstanding verification honestly rather than asserting a 'Verified:' note nobody can check — the register already carries 53 of those. allows_redistribution=0: we state counts, we do not redistribute the catalogue.

elar._basis: Per-deposit access controls; metadata only. Sovereignty-sensitive — never serve content.

wurm-hattori-pacific-atlas.attribution: Wurm, S. A. & Hattori, S. (eds.) 1981-1983. Language Atlas of the Pacific Area. Australian Academy of the Humanities / Japan Academy.
wurm-hattori-pacific-atlas._basis: FOUNDER RULING 2026-08-01: state the fact, cite the source. Facts are not copyrightable and citing the work they come from is ordinary scholarship, so a per-language claim carrying a real citation stays. NO TEXT from either work is reproduced. What does NOT survive is any claim copied verbatim across hundreds of cards — the atlas truth pass removes those regardless (arealContext is 99 distinct strings over 14,141 instances). allows_redistribution stays 0: we hold no grant to the work itself. | Supersedes the retired LicenseRef-Copyrighted-Reference / LicenseRef-Literature-Citation pseudo-licences, which asserted allows_redistribution = 1 over copyrighted works on the register's own authority. Wurm, S. A. & Hattori, S. (eds.) 1981-1983. Language Atlas of the Pacific Area.

sails.attribution: South American Indigenous Language Structures (SAILS). cldf-datasets/sails.
sails._basis: Zenodo deposit (10.5281/zenodo.3608862, resource_type=dataset) declares licence id 'cc-nc' — Creative Commons NonCommercial, version not stated. The register said Apache-2.0, a CODE licence applied to a typological dataset. NonCommercial is recorded because the depositor stated it; the VERSION is not, because they did not, and inventing one is the exact defect this pass removed from toSpdx(). Cited by 165 language cards.
